# ITECS AI

> ITECS AI is the Dallas-based AI consulting, automation, training, and managed intelligence practice of Itecs Outsourcing, LLC, a managed IT and cybersecurity provider founded in 2002.

Use the linked canonical pages as the source for current service scope, pricing, evidence, and contact details. The descriptions below are navigation summaries. This file does not replace robots.txt, sitemap.xml, contractual terms, or the separate ITECS AI crawler-use statement.

Canonical company facts:

- Legal entity: Itecs Outsourcing, LLC
- Brand: ITECS AI
- Founded: 2002
- Office: 17304 Preston Rd. Ste 460, Dallas, TX 75252
- Service area: Dallas-Fort Worth and remote United States engagements
- Phone: (214) 444-7884
- Toll-free phone: (877) 483-2710
- Email: sales-inquiry@itecsonline.com
- Google Maps: [View ITECS on Google Maps](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oFDotCsqC2SpdppV6)

## Strategy, Governance, and Operations

- [AI consulting](https://itecs.ai/consulting): AI readiness, workflow selection, governance, planning, and vendor-neutral implementation guidance.
- [Managed Intelligence Provider](https://itecs.ai/managed-intelligence-provider): ITECS operating model for governed agents, automations, model selection, monitoring, security, optimization, and executive reporting.
- [Custom AI agents](https://itecs.ai/custom-ai-agents): Governed agents and assistants connected to approved business context, tools, permissions, human review, and production support.
- [AI workflow automation](https://itecs.ai/automation): Bounded automation for recurring business workflows, including guided builds and governed implementation handoffs.
- [AI DevOps](https://itecs.ai/ai-devops): Versioned deployment, evaluation, monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing production operations for AI systems.
- [Data and AI readiness](https://itecs.ai/data-audit): Fixed-scope readiness work for mapping approved data, access, risks, owners, and a build-ready first use case.

## Managed Agent Products

- [ITECS OpsMemory](https://itecs.ai/ai-knowledge-base): Managed knowledge and document operations using structured Markdown, indexes, full body content, citations, and relative media links to produce reviewed answers, SOPs, and runbooks from approved sources.
- [ITECS Change Assurance](https://itecs.ai/it-change-readiness): Read-only AI-assisted IT change reviews that challenge plans, check official requirements, require and record technician-reported live verification for critical prerequisites, and produce an auditable readiness verdict; it never executes, approves, remediates, or rolls back the change.
- [AI receptionist](https://itecs.ai/ai-receptionist): Voice-agent implementation for call answering, intake, routing, scheduling, escalation, and managed operation.
- [CRM and sales AI](https://itecs.ai/crm-sales-ai): Governed sales and CRM workflows for lead handling, follow-up, pipeline operations, and approved system actions.

## Training and Enablement

- [AI training](https://itecs.ai/training): Role-based AI training, governance education, workflow practice, and team adoption support.
- [Claude Cowork training](https://itecs.ai/claude-cowork-training): Governed Claude Cowork configuration and enablement for approved business workflows.
- [ChatGPT and Codex training](https://itecs.ai/chatgpt-codex-training): Role-based ChatGPT and Codex implementation guidance covering workspace controls, data handling, review, and practical workflows.
- [Microsoft Copilot training](https://itecs.ai/copilot-training): Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness, permissions review, use-case design, and employee enablement.
- [AI Champion Program](https://itecs.ai/services/ai-champion-program): Structured enablement for developing an internal AI lead with coaching, governance support, reusable guidance, and post-program support.

## Industry Solutions

- [Manufacturing AI](https://itecs.ai/manufacturing): Manufacturing finance and operations use cases, control boundaries, implementation sequence, and related solution pages.
- [Purchase price variance agent](https://itecs.ai/manufacturing/ppv-agent): Governed PPV analysis workflow for tracing material-cost variance to approved purchasing and finance records.
- [Financial services AI](https://itecs.ai/financial-services): Governed AI workflows for lenders, field examination, cash-flow analysis, portfolio monitoring, and receivables operations.
- [Field Examination Analyzer](https://itecs.ai/financial-services/field-examination-analyzer): Evidence-linked field-examination workflow that preserves review, exceptions, and human decision ownership.
